MEMORANDUM (Privileged)
To: Margaret Chen. From: David Kowalski. Date: May 20, 2025. Re: Pinebrook follow-on - Northgate Sullivan redline (May 19) of our May 14 Underwriting Agreement (UA). R = redline section; [O] = our draft. C = Critical, S = Significant, M = Minor. PB = Playbook v4.2.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Bottom line: The redline breaches PB red lines on indemnity cap, "alleged" trigger, Underwriter Information, contribution, indemnity floor, lock-up release, quiet period, MAC termination, expense cap, survival and negative-assurance scope. None is acceptable; each exceeds the PB maximum compromise and needs your approval before response (PB XIV). Threshold warning: the redline's "deleted" text does not match our May 14 draft, and it contains untracked changes (flagged "Untracked" below); tracked changes are not the complete change set. Run a full comparison against our file before the call; if red lines are unresolved, move pricing 1-2 days (PB XV).

Call roadmap (priority order):
1. Cap deleted (R8(a)): reinstate $200M ($230M with option). PB ceiling 150% ($300M/$345M), your approval only.
2. "Actual or alleged" trigger (R8(a)): reject; offer only separate advancement with repayment undertaking.
3. Underwriter Information cut to names/addresses (R1): no compromise.
4. Contribution on relative benefit (R9): about 95/5 against Company.
5. Underwriter indemnity floor and contribution cap "net of offering-related expenses" (R8(b), R9).
6. Lock-up release needs Clearwater consent (R5(f), Exh. A): board priority; fallback notice only.
7. New quiet period (R5(g)): reject; Reg FD/Exchange Act conflict.
8. Company MAC termination right (R10(a)(iv)) and loosened catch-all (R10(a)(v)).
9. Uncapped expense reimbursement "regardless of reason" (R10(b)): restore $150,000.
10. Indefinite survival (R3): 18 months.
11. Negative assurance extended to FWPs, testing-the-waters, investor presentations (R7(d), Exh. C): our exposure.
12. Overallotment 45 days (R2(b)): 30; maximum 35.

PART A - SECTION-BY-SECTION

1. DEFINITIONS
R1 "Underwriter Information" [O1] - C. Orig: names/addresses, share allocations, and three paragraphs on stabilization, over-allotment, penalty bids. Redline: names and addresses only. PB IX/XIV #12: red line, no compromise. Effect: Company indemnifies underwriter-drafted trading disclosure; R3(a) carve-out and R8(b) shrink too. Reject. Do not rely on paragraph numbers: the redline's deleted text says "third, fourth, fifth", PB says third/fifth/seventh, and the Prospectus puts them at S-7.3 (overallotment), S-7.5 (stabilization), S-7.7 (penalty bids), with only S-7.5/S-7.7 labeled underwriter-provided. Proposed: "'Underwriter Information' means (i) the names, addresses and share allocations of the Underwriters in the Prospectus Supplement and Schedule I; (ii) the paragraphs under 'Underwriting' captioned 'Overallotment Option,' 'Stabilization Transactions' and 'Penalty Bids' (and the related short-sale paragraph); and (iii) any other information identified in writing by the Underwriters as furnished for use in the Registration Statement or Prospectus." Consider adding S-7.8 (Electronic Distribution) and S-7.9 (FINRA).

2. SALE AND DELIVERY
R2(b) overallotment period, 30th to 45th day - S. PB II yellow; 45 days = July 11, 2025 vs June 26. Counter 30; ceiling 35 days (July 1) with written justification and your approval. Prospectus S-7.3 discloses 30 days as "arm's-length negotiated," so any change requires prospectus revision before pricing. Size (1,200,000 = 15%), 80/20 split, $25.00 price, $1.25 (5.0%) discount and $23.75 net are unchanged and tie to the Prospectus and Sched. I.
R2(c) DTC eligibility rep - M, standard (PB green): accept.
Untracked: option closing window changed from 0-3 to 2-5 business days; venue moved to Northgate's office; [O1] "third business day after pricing" replaced by fixed May 27. May 22 pricing plus three business days is May 28 (Memorial Day May 26); May 27 is T+2; PB's "T+3" is stale (Rule 15c6-1 T+1 since May 28, 2024). Confirm pricing time and Rule 15c6-1(c)/(d) basis (unverified). Venue: M.

3. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
R3 survival [O3, O12] - C. 18 months (through Nov. 27, 2026) replaced by "without limitation as to time"; Exh. B conformed. PB III red; fallback 24 months, your approval; indefinite rejected and escalated. Untracked: claim-notice tail dropped; only Company reps covered. Markup: "...shall survive for eighteen (18) months following the Closing Date (through November 27, 2026); no claim may be made thereafter unless written notice was given before expiry. Underwriter representations survive on the same terms."
R3(e) PCAOB sentence - M, standard (PB green): accept.
Untracked (S): R3(f) MAC rep adds "any development that would reasonably be expected to result in" an MAC; new insurance, environmental, ERISA, FCPA, cyber and General Disclosure Package reps. Strike the forward-looking MAC phrase; require knowledge/materiality qualifiers.

4. UNDERWRITER REPS AND COVENANTS
R4(c) FINRA - S (untracked). [O4(c)] stated Rule 5110 compliance, compensation within limits, filing made, "sole responsibility of the Underwriters." Redline: general rule compliance plus Redfield retention; R7(h) makes Redfield's confirmation a closing condition. PB IV red: broad rep covering Rules 5110/5121 and all compensation (Clearwater $8.5M incl. $500,000 advisory fee; Oakmont $2.0M); no consultant-reliance language. Restore [O4(c)]; delete Redfield from R7(h).
R4(e) prospectus delivery (Securities Act ss.5(b), 10) - M, standard: accept.
Untracked: [O4(e)] no-unauthorized-representations and [O6(c)] no-unauthorized-FWP covenant were dropped. Restore (S); otherwise Company indemnity reaches underwriter FWPs (see 7).

5. COVENANTS
R5(f) lock-up release - C. Orig: Company sole authority [O7(b): "absolute," no consent]. Redline: Lead Underwriter prior written consent, "sole discretion." Exh. A conformed. PB V.C/XII red; fallback only 3 business days' advance notice with Company final say, no "not unreasonably withheld" consent. Contradicts Prospectus S-7.4. Markup: "The Company may waive or release any Lock-Up Agreement in its sole discretion on three (3) Business Days' prior written notice to the Representative; no Underwriter consent is required." Untracked (S): Exh. A drops 10b5-1, estate-planning and affiliate carve-outs [O Sched. II]; "reasonable best efforts" became "shall cause" (Company cannot compel 5% holders); Company lock-up carve-outs [O7(c)(A)-(D)] (option exercises, RSU vesting, equity plans, acquisitions) cut to Form S-8. Restore all.
R5(g) quiet period - C. New: pricing through fifth business day after closing (June 3), no press release, public statement, clinical data statement or SEC filing without Clearwater consent, "sole discretion," 2 business days' written request, breach "material," surviving termination. PB V.B: consent covenant and post-closing restriction both red; yellow alternative is 24-48 hour notice, legal-disclosure/SEC/Reg FD carve-out, ending at closing. Only clause (iii) has a "required by law" exception. See Part C. Markup: "Before the Closing Date the Company shall, where practicable, give the Representative 24 hours' notice of press releases; nothing herein restricts any disclosure or filing required by law, the Exchange Act, Regulation FD or Nasdaq rules." Delete material-breach and survival language.
Untracked (S): [O5(j)] Exchange Act reporting covenant dropped; R5(d) use of proceeds omits $35M preclinical and $15M capex in the Prospectus (restore "as described in the Prospectus"); R5(a) Representative may "reasonably object" to filings, so add carve-out for Exchange Act reports.
R5(e) blue sky - M, standard (PB green): accept; the no-foreign-qualification proviso helps.

6. CONDITIONS
R7(d) negative assurance - C (our exposure). Orig: Registration Statement and Prospectus. Redline adds FWPs "filed or used by or on behalf of" the Company, TTW communications and investor presentations; Exh. C conformed. PB VI: TTW/investor presentations red, never; fallback only Company-filed FWPs after adequate review. Counter: original scope; at most Company-filed FWPs. Untracked: [O8(f)] "without independent verification," discussions with officers, and "other procedures specified" were removed; restore.
R7(j) market-out condition (untracked) - S. Duplicates R10 termination; PB VI says no standalone market-outs. Our own [O8(m)] had a Company-specific limb, itself off-playbook; delete R7(j). Also R7(h) Redfield (above); officer certificate lost its "knowledge after reasonable inquiry" qualifier (restore); R7(k) Secretary and good-standing certificates - M, customary, accept.

7. INDEMNIFICATION AND CONTRIBUTION
R8(a) cap deleted - C. [O9(a)] cap at gross proceeds ($200M; $230M with option). PB VII.A: hard red, no fallback; board's top concern; Company had about $185M cash at 3/31/25. Reinstate verbatim, including the $230M alternative (omitted from the redline's deleted text).
R8(a) "actual or alleged" - C. PB red; Company would owe on a bare complaint, before adjudication. Counter: actual untrue statement or omission only (tracks Securities Act ss.11/12); compromise only a separate advancement clause: advances on written request, with undertaking to repay if not ultimately entitled.
R8(a) untracked - C. Indemnity now covers "any free writing prospectus" (not just those authorized by the Company) and General Disclosure Package, with the narrower Underwriter Information carve-out, so Company bears underwriters' own FWPs. Restore "authorized for use by the Company."
R8(b) floor net of "offering-related expenses" - C. PB VII.B red; fallback only documented third-party legal fees up to $250,000 per underwriter. Floors $8M/$2M. Untracked: [O9(b)] minimums ($8M/$2M/$10M) and "no cap on Underwriters' obligations" deleted; redline also adds "alleged" to Underwriter indemnity (helps us). Restore.
R9 contribution - C. Relative fault replaced with relative benefit (net proceeds $190M vs discount $10M, so Company bears 95%; a $20M loss would be $19M Company/$1M underwriters); the "benefit alone is not equitable" sentence deleted; underwriter cap now net of expenses. PB VIII red; fallback: hybrid, fault primary. Cap should be each underwriter's total compensation without expense deductions: Clearwater $8.5M, Oakmont $2.0M. [O9(d)] used aggregate discount ($10M/$11.5M), so our own draft understates Clearwater by the $500,000 advisory fee; fix. Redline also computes the advisory fee on "aggregate gross proceeds" while [O11(a)] used Firm Shares ($500,000 vs $575,000 on $230M): confirm.

8. TERMINATION AND EXPENSES
R10(a)(iv) company MAC - C. "Any MAC in the business, financial condition, or results... whether or not arising in the ordinary course," no marketability nexus. PB X red: converts firm commitment into best efforts; PBX-4071 data is a foreseeable trigger. Fallback (your approval): unforeseen, undisclosed, marketability-based. Untracked: R10(a)(v) now reaches "any other event or condition" (not just market calamity), and [O10(a)] "exclusive grounds" sentence was deleted; restore both. No Company termination right in either draft; PB X yellow asks for one: add as a trade.
R10(b) expenses - C. Orig: reasonable documented expenses, $150,000 cap, 30 days after documentation. Redline: all out-of-pocket expenses "regardless of the reason," payable on demand. PB XI red: cap holds; no reimbursement on without-cause termination; fallback $200,000 for cause, or $75,000 without cause/$150,000 for cause if scope expands. PB: uncapped may reach $500K-$1M; Prospectus S-7.2 discloses $150,000. Untracked: Company-expense clause [O11(a)], advisory-fee mechanics and "Underwriters bear own expenses on closing" [O11(b)] vanished; restore.

9. MISCELLANEOUS
Governing law (NY), Manhattan courts, counterparts, notices, severability: M, accept. Untracked: jury-waiver [O13(d)], no-third-party-beneficiary and several-obligations [O13(k),(l)] clauses removed; restore as neutral (M). Company address: UA and Prospectus say 200 Technology Square; PB says 400.

PART B - STANDARD ITEMS: blue sky, DTC eligibility, prospectus delivery, PCAOB language, R7(k) certificates, Nasdaq listing, comfort letters, notices: acceptable; no call time.

PART C - REGULATORY AND COMPLIANCE FLAGS (separate)
1. Quiet period (R5(g)). A consent-based ban on "public statements" about clinical data cannot override Exchange Act s.13(a) reporting (Form 8-K, four business days), Regulation FD (17 CFR 243.101(d): public disclosure within 24 hours or next trading day after an unintentional selective disclosure), Nasdaq Rule 5250(b)(1) (prompt disclosure of material information), or the duty to supplement a misleading prospectus (Securities Act ss.11, 12(a)(2); Rule 159) (unverified against current text). With PBX-4071 Phase 2 data possible at any time, the 2-business-day request period and "sole discretion" create an impossible compliance conflict. Only clause (iii) has a "required by law" exception.
2. Indemnification public policy. SEC views Securities Act indemnification as unenforceable (Reg. S-K Items 510/512(h)); courts limit it (Eichenholtz v. Brennan, 3d Cir. 1995, which PB cites for relative fault) (unverified). Section 11(f) contribution supports fault-based allocation.
3. Prospectus consistency. Preliminary Prospectus discloses 30-day option (S-7.3), Company-sole lock-up release (S-7.4), $150,000 expense cap (S-7.2). Redline terms would make these statements inaccurate at the time of sale (Rule 159) and require recirculation or supplement and a Rule 424(b) conformity check.
4. FINRA: uncapped reimbursement is likely underwriting compensation, yet Prospectus S-7.9 states total compensation will not exceed 5.25% (unverified).
5. FWP/TTW (Rules 433, 163B) negative assurance expands H&W liability.
6. Settlement cycle: see R2(c).

PART D - NEXT STEPS
(1) Full comparison against our file; ask Northgate to confirm its base document; (2) escalate red-line items to you before responding; (3) log consideration for yellow concessions (35-day option, notice-only quiet period, FWP fallback); (4) conform Prospectus; (5) verify cited authorities and the S-3 file number/date history (333-278451).
